question: With fresh Sobol(q0 x ω-dir) starts at fixed-correct harvested ω-mag, does 5-DOF LM reach the loose truth basin (is the ω-mag prior sufficient)?
hypothesis: Correct ω-mag alone (Option C) is a sufficient prior to bridge the q0 + ω-dir search gap into the truth basin.
narrative_md: ω-mag prior is structurally insufficient. With fresh Sobol(q0 x ω-dir) starts at fixed-correct harvested ω-mag, 0/7 seeds reach loose basin — including seed 28 where harvested ω-mag was 0.01% from truth (effectively perfect). Option C is closed: ω-mag accuracy alone cannot bridge the q0 + ω-dir gap. Reframe: the cohort selector returns candidates with surr-MSE 0.005-0.011 mag^2 (Band A by proxy) on seeds 13/41/79 — multi-solution attractors (q0 80-173° + ω-dir 73-122° off, LC still matches); hi-fi ρ-band deferred to s017. 960 LM runs.
